items.heading: Mamaliga
details: Key ingredients: corn meal, water, cheese, sour cream
Whisk corn meal into boiling salted water.
Stir continuously until it thickens into a smooth, firm porridge.
Pour onto a board and let it set slightly before slicing.
Serve with crumbled cheese and a spoonful of sour cream.

items.heading: Zeama
details: Key ingredients: chicken, noodles, vegetables, sour cream
Simmer a whole chicken with vegetables into a light broth.
Shred the cooked chicken and return it to the pot.
Add thin noodles and cook until tender.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream and fresh herbs.
